newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures rally to sharply higher close.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures rally to sharply higher close.

text.p: Oct 29 - U.S. debt futures rallied to a sharply higher close. Dec T-bonds rose to 112-22/32, retracing almost 50-percent of the 9-1/2-mos downmove. Many traders were surprised at the resiliency of the market's rally above the seven-mos high of 111-28/32. Q3 ECI, consumer confidence erased fears of a Fed rate hike this year, they said. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
